author: GodEmperorDoge
name: Watch
short: Preload library media or request a movie/TV download.
description: Preload library media or request English movie/TV downloads with owner-managed permissions, shared per-user season retention, and download progress.
install_msg: Set the API token with the PRELOAD_BOT_TOKEN environment variable or `[p]set api media_preload token,<token>` (and url,<url> if it isn't http://host.containers.internal:8125).
end_user_data_statement: Stores a linked Jellyfin name, download permission, and one selected TV season per show per Discord user. watch unlink removes the name; Red user-data deletion clears all choices and permissions without immediately deleting shared media.
